# Outcomes of pancreas transplantation in recipients with HIV

The goal of this analysis is to compare outcomes after kidney–pancreas and pancreas-alone transplantation between recipients with and without HIV. It uses the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR) standard analysis files, with recipients matched on a propensity score.

This analysis is in progress. The repository currently holds the analysis plan and project structure; the code is being rebuilt on the [sRtr](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/sRtr) package.

The full analysis website, which explains the code step by step, is available at:
https://vagishhemmige.github.io/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/

## Documentation

- [`analysis-plan.md`](analysis-plan.md): what the analysis is meant to do
- [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md): how the code is organized
- [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repository
- [Issues](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-pancreas-2024-srtr/issues): open decisions and known gaps

## Running the analysis

Run `R/main.R` from the project root. Requires authorized access to the SRTR standard analysis files under the SRTR data use agreement, located through the sRtr package (`sRtr::set_srtr_wd()`). No SRTR data or outputs derived from them are stored in this repository.
